other_conditions: Preference is given to small and marginal farmers.
Farmers who have previously received a tube‑well mining grant under any scheme are ineligible.
benefits_summary: Provides a mining grant up to ₹10,000 for general farmers (₹18,000 for SC/ST) and a pump‑installation subsidy up to ₹20,000 for general farmers (₹25,000 for SC/ST).
